name: Scramble

faq.answer: Scramble sends travelers along a scavenged trail to a hidden cache. A note directs them one hundred paces north down a treacherous cliff to buried supplies.
The note places the cache about one hundred paces due north, down a steep cliffside. Careful footing is needed on the way down.
faq.q: Where is the hidden stash located?

faq.answer: The note does not name its author. Its informal, practical directions help an explorer find emergency provisions, and the stash remains intact.
faq.q: Who left the note and the cache?

faq.answer: The buried messenger bag holds survival supplies and a dirty parchment tucked among them.
faq.q: What is inside the buried stash?

faq.answer: The dirty parchment is inside the buried messenger bag, alongside the provisions. It is found when the bag is pulled from the ground.
faq.q: What is the dirty parchment found with the supplies?

faq.answer: The steep northern descent is the chief hazard. A misstep can mean broken ankles or a serious fall.
faq.q: What hazards are involved in reaching the cache?

sections.body: A note points the way to a hidden supply cache. Its writer offers a few informal words of encouragement, then gives precise directions: go one hundred paces due north down the treacherous cliffside. Provisions wait there to keep a traveler going.
sections.title: The Northward Trail

sections.body: Following the directions down the steep cliff face leads to a buried messenger bag. Inside are practical survival supplies and another dirty parchment. The note points onward along a larger trail.
sections.title: Unearthing the Messenger Bag

summary: A scavenger's note sends travelers down a steep cliff in search of Scramble's hidden supplies. One hundred paces north, they find provisions and a dirty parchment.
